##### Project general facts

Remraam is a modern residential community in Dubailand offering a selection of 1-, 2-, and 2+ bedroom apartments designed for comfortable and active family living. Surrounded by lush green landscapes, the community combines contemporary homes with spacious outdoor areas and convenient access to everyday facilities. Thoughtfully planned surroundings create a peaceful environment while keeping residents connected to the city.

The community offers a wide range of amenities and outdoor activities for residents of all ages. Landscaped gardens, cycling trails, jogging tracks, shaded areas, and swimming pools provide plenty of opportunities for recreation, relaxation, and family time. The combination of green open spaces and modern lifestyle facilities creates a balanced environment where residents can enjoy an active lifestyle close to nature.

The apartments feature practical interiors with durable and contemporary finishes, including porcelain or ceramic tile flooring, emulsion-painted walls, and moisture-resistant gypsum board ceilings in selected areas. Bathrooms are fitted with solid composite basins and vanities, stainless steel hardware, chrome-plated mixer taps, and quality sanitary ware. The kitchens are equipped with a built-in hood, refrigerator, hob, oven, and dishwasher, while the apartments are offered unfurnished.

##### Location description and benefits

Remraam is a peaceful, family-oriented residential community located in Al Hebiah 5 within Dubailand. Positioned near Emirates Road (E611) and Hessa Street (D61), the community offers convenient connectivity to major areas of Dubai while maintaining a relaxed suburban atmosphere. Its location also provides easy access to Motor City, Dubai Sports City, Dubai Investments Park, and other established residential and leisure destinations.

The community is surrounded by spacious green areas and is designed to support an active outdoor lifestyle. Residents can enjoy landscaped parks, swimming pools, playgrounds, jogging and cycling routes, sports courts, barbecue areas, and community facilities, creating a comfortable environment for families and everyday recreation. Retail and dining options within the community add further convenience.

Remraam also benefits from its proximity to major destinations across Dubai. Al Maktoum International Airport is approximately 15 minutes away, while Global Village, Motor City, and Dubai Investments Park are also within convenient driving distance. With its combination of greenery, family-friendly facilities, and strong road connectivity, Remraam offers a balanced suburban lifestyle away from the city's busiest areas.
